summary: Catalog genealogy of 24 servers vs HalabTech's 10:03 UTC catalogs (470 IMEI / 985 server SKUs). There are three clusters. (1) API mirrors downstream of HalabTech (reunlocker, mwunlocker, gsmtiger, univgsm, saudi-gsm), which carry HalabTech-internal test SKUs and the HalabTech Point SKU. (2) UnlocksPro, which turns out to be downstream for HalabTech-proprietary products. (3) Upstream candidates with no HalabTech branding and consistently lower prices: Code-GSM for the Xiaomi family, T-Mobile Clean & Paid Off and FMI OFF; GSM Nigeria for tool activations and FMI OFF; GSMFATHER as the probable origin of the NNNN# Moldova names. Code-GSM equals GSM Nigeria + $2.00 on 45 of 47 shared SKUs.
method: Exa web_fetch (maxCharacters 200k-600k) of /resellerpricing/imei and /server pages. The parser is in r7/scripts/W6/parse_any.py (Dhru table, ReUnlocker, cleanunlocker, GSM-Tool and productsandservices layouts; the trailing delivery time is stripped from names). Two kinds of name match: exact (whitespace and pipe-normalised, case-sensitive) and loose (alphanumeric only, leading NNNN#/#NNNN ID stripped). Group-name overlap is measured; group order uses Kendall tau. Branding = 'halab tech' in a name or group. Typos are scored against a curated list plus an edit-distance detector. Price ratios cover uniquely matched SKUs. HalabTech implied costs (r7/raw/markup_*.json) are matched to other servers' prices within 0.5% or $0.01, and the FMI OFF family is matched by model key (r7/scripts/W6/*.py). Code-GSM and GSM Nigeria were re-captured live with Firecrawl (maxAge 0) at 10:29 UTC because Exa copies can be stale: the Code-GSM Exa copy showed Honduras at $17, the live page shows $54.
